content.body:
The worst thing for your GLP-1 plateau is increasing your dose.

The best thing for your GLP-1 plateau is lowering cortisol.

The worst thing for your cortisol on the skinny shot is cutting calories further and exercising more.

The best thing for your cortisol is L-Theanine.

The worst thing for your sleep on GLP-1 is a general magnesium supplement.

The best thing for your sleep is Magnesium Bisglycinate paired with Saffron.

The worst thing for your hair loss on GLP-1 is a biotin supplement.

The best thing for your hair is to address the cortisol that flagged your follicles as nonessential.

The worst thing for your energy on the skinny shot is another cup of coffee.

The best thing for your energy is Methylcobalamin B12 with Vitamin C.

The worst thing for your digestion on GLP-1 is fiber gummies.

The best thing for your digestion is Ginger Extract standardized to gingerols.

Instead of a stack of individual supplements that weren't formulated for each other…

I'd recommend the Zafira Recovery Protocol, with all 6 ingredients working as a system.

Ginger, L-Theanine, Saffron, Magnesium, B12, and Vitamin C — everything your body needs while on GLP-1, in one daily protocol.

So you can start losing weight again, sleep better, and have energy during the day.

Just like 12,847+ women already are.

I go deeper into the science behind each ingredient — and the full Zafira Recovery Protocol — in the article linked below.

Tap the button below to read it right now.

Josephine Hawthorn, RN, MS
Registered Nurse & GLP-1 Specialist
